answer: An adversary running 50 aliases therefore needs 61 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in hollow, expire in cedar, and bridge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2519 identities would post 4104 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
